entities.summary: Black conservatism is a political and social philosophy emphasizing traditionalism, patriotism, self-sufficiency, and strong cultural and social conservatism within the context of the black church. In the United States it is often, but not exclusively, associated with the Republican Party. black conservatism is a political ideology.
